name: Rot Hide Ichor
summary: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel gathers Rot Hide Ichor for the Royal Apothecary Society. They hope it will show what corrupted the gnolls and how to oppose them.

sections.title: A Plague in the Blood
sections.body: On Fenris Isle, the Rot Hide gnolls are twisted by an unnatural blight. Their bodies decay, yet a noxious ichor runs through their veins and sustains their animated flesh. The Royal Apothecary Society hopes the fluid will reveal what corrupted the pack and who commands them from within the ruined keep.

sections.title: Apothecary Research
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel gathers vials of the ichor for study. The Forsaken hope to separate the chemical and magical forces that sustain the gnolls. Then they can find the pack's weaknesses before sending troops across Lordamere Lake in a full assault.

faq.q: Where does Rot Hide Ichor come from?
aliases: where to get rot hide ichor
how to find rot hide ichor
faq.answer: Rot Hide Ichor comes from the Rot Hide gnolls on Fenris Isle, in Lordamere Lake east of Silverpine Forest's mainland.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel want this ichor?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel studies the fluid to learn what corrupted the gnolls and find physical or alchemical weaknesses the Forsaken can use before attacking the island.

faq.q: Are the Rot Hide gnolls Scourge?
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls are undead and warped by plague. The Forsaken are investigating who or what created them and commands them on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Do all gnolls have this ichor?
faq.answer: No. This ichor belongs to the Rot Hide pack, whose flesh and blood are corrupted by foul necromantic blights.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see why studying the ichor matters. It may offer military intelligence to secure Silverpine's eastern flank and advance the Royal Apothecary Society's mastery of plague science.
